operations.name: shape.add_group
operations.description: Add a Vector Group to a shape layer's Contents.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index or name (must be a shape layer)

operations.name: shape.add_rect
operations.description: Add a Rectangle Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_ellipse
operations.description: Add an Ellipse Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_fill
operations.description: Add a Fill to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_path
operations.description: Add a custom bezier Path (vertices + tangents) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_trim_paths
operations.description: Add Trim Paths to a shape group. Essential for shape animation (line draw-on effects).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_merge_paths
operations.description: Add Merge Paths to a shape group for combining/subtracting shapes.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_stroke
operations.description: Add a Stroke to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_polystar
operations.description: Add a Polystar Path (star or polygon) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: innerRadius
params.description: Inner radius in px (star type only)

operations.name: shape.add_repeater
operations.description: Add a Repeater to a shape group — duplicates the group's contents with a per-copy transform offset.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_rounded_corners
operations.description: Add Rounded Corners to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_offset_paths
operations.description: Add Offset Paths to a shape group (grow/shrink outlines).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: amount
params.description: Offset in px (positive grows, negative shrinks)

operations.name: shape.add_wiggle_paths
operations.description: Add Wiggle Paths (roughen) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_zigzag
operations.description: Add Zig Zag to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_pucker_bloat
operations.description: Add Pucker & Bloat to a shape group (negative = pucker, positive = bloat).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_twist
operations.description: Add Twist to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_gradient_fill
operations.description: Add a Gradient Fill to a shape group. Type and start/end points are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE (defaults to white-to-black — edit stops manually or via a preset).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_gradient_stroke
operations.description: Add a Gradient Stroke to a shape group. Type, points, and width are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: shape.add_wiggle_transform
operations.description: Add Wiggle Transform to a shape group - randomizes position/scale/rotation over time (the transform-space sibling of Wiggle Paths).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: transform.set
operations.description: Set transform properties on one or more layers. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. For keyframes use keyframe.add.
